by the act of June 25, 1910, c. 421, 36

ordered as follows:
Sec. 1. Executive Order No. 6039 of

turage and other purposes, is hereby re­
voked insofar as it affects the following- 
described lands:

vey No. 1272;

11^,‘  to the place of beginning.

on Kodiak Island, Alaska, having a total
